name: Spark Flick
description: A snap of the fingers flings a stinging spark.

name: Soothing Touch
description: A warm palm eases a bruise or a shallow cut.

name: Chill Breath
description: A breath of frost that leaves the target sluggish.

name: Dazzle
description: A flash of light bursts before the target's eyes.

name: Muffle
description: Sudden silence wraps the target's ears.

name: Tripwire Hex
description: An unseen cord snags the target's ankle.

name: Ember Dart
description: A hissing dart of flame that leaves its mark smouldering.

name: Searing Brand
description: A glowing sigil sears itself onto the target's skin.

name: Smoke Veil
description: Choking smoke rolls over a knot of foes.

name: Cinder Cloud
description: A cloud of burning cinders settles over an area.

name: Pyre Lance
description: A white-hot spear of flame lances across the field.

name: Shade Bolt
description: A bolt of cold darkness that bites to the bone.

name: Grasping Shadows
description: The target's own shadow clutches at its legs.

name: Gloam Daze
description: Dusk floods the target's mind and stalls its thoughts.

name: Pall of Dread
description: A grey pall settles and courage drains away.

name: Hollow Scream
description: A soundless scream that cracks stone and eardrums alike.

name: Mending Moss
description: Damp moss pressed to a wound knits the flesh.

name: Fen Fog
description: A clammy marsh fog that weighs down the limbs.

name: Bramble Snare
description: Thorny runners burst from the ground around the target.

name: Sour Blood
description: The target's blood curdles and burns in its veins.

name: Withering Glance
description: A long stare that saps the strength from a body.

name: Crow-Knot Curse
description: A knotted cord pulled tight opens old wounds anew.

name: Hearth Mending
description: A murmured hearth-prayer that closes a cut.

name: Hearth Spark
description: A spark from the hearth leaps at the faithful's foe.

name: Hearthward Rebuke
description: A stern word that drives a foe to its knees.

name: Hush of the Hearth
description: A hush falls over the target like a banked fire.

name: Mercy of the Hearth
description: Warmth spreads through the faithful and wounds close.

name: Hearthfire Smite
description: A column of hearthfire falls upon the wicked.

name: Stilling Word
description: A single holy word that freezes foes mid-stride.

name: Last Light
description: The last ember of the hearth rekindles a failing life.

name: Leech Touch
description: A cold touch that drains a little warmth from living flesh.

name: Flame Curtain
description: A wall of flickering flame rises in front of a foe and licks at it.

name: True North Sense
description: Instant. The caster at once knows which way is true north.

name: Gentle Beast
description: Range 3 ft, 1 target, 1 hour. A beast smaller than the caster trusts it like a friend for the duration.

name: Leaf Light Tread
description: Self, Agility minutes. Nothing organic breaks underfoot; trackers in rural terrain suffer -3 SL.

name: Larder Keeping
description: Range 3 ft, WPB days. About a day of rations will not rot or go stale, though fire and damp still harm them.

name: Distant Ear
description: Range IB yd, 1 target, WPB minutes. The caster hears what the target says as if standing beside it.

name: Carried Whisper
description: Range WP yd, WPB rounds. The caster’s voice sounds from a chosen point in range, whatever the line of sight.

name: Candle Gust
description: Range WP yd, instant. A brief gust that snuffs a candle, slams a door or scatters a few pages.

name: Lantern Glow
description: Self, WP minutes. A torch-like light glows from the caster; an Average (+2 SL) Willpower test dims or brightens it.

name: Tumbler Ease
description: Touch, 1 target, instant. One non-magical lock the caster touches springs open.

name: Hat Critter
description: Touch, instant. Produces a small animal native to the area from a pocket or burrow; its temper is not guaranteed.

name: Palm Flame
description: Self, WPB rounds. A harmless flame in the palm gives off heat and ignites flammable objects; it deals no damage.

name: Wisp Lanterns
description: Range WP yd, WP minutes. Up to IntB drifting lights like lanterns; an Average (+2 SL) Willpower test steers them at walking pace.

name: Dry Cloak
description: Self, WPB hours. The caster and their gear stay dry in rain, hail, sleet and snow, but not in standing water.

name: Clear Cup
description: Range 3 ft, instant. Purifies the water in one vessel; drinks that are mostly water become plain clean water.

name: Quick Mould
description: Range 3 ft, instant. A fist-sized lump of organic matter rots at once; leather armour loses 1 AP on one location.

name: Static Bite
description: A shocking spark that leaves the target stunned until the end of the caster’s next turn.

name: Thumb Spring
description: Touch, WPB rounds. Water bubbles from the ground at 1 pint per round, up to IB pints in total.

name: Nudge
description: Range half WP yd, 1 target, instant. A small object shifts slightly; a holder drops it unless an Average Dexterity test is passed.

name: Drowse Touch
description: Touch, 1 target, WPB rounds. The target falls into deep sleep (unconscious if prone); noise or a jostle wakes it at once.

name: Palm Hop
description: Self, instant. A fist-sized object carried on the caster’s person leaps into their hand.

name: Phantom Murmurs
description: Range WP yd, WPB rounds. Quiet, vague noises come from a chosen spot; an Average (+2 SL) Willpower test moves or hushes them.

name: Tainted Sense
description: Range 3 ft, 1 target, instant. The caster notes at once whether an object is poisoned, infected or trapped.

name: Mantle Ward
description: Self, WPB rounds. The caster gains +1 AP on every hit location.

name: Conjured Edge
description: Self, WPB rounds. The caster conjures a magical melee weapon of choice from the weapon tables.

name: Shaft Turning
description: Self, WPB-yard area, WPB rounds. Missiles with organic parts are destroyed on entering the area; metal ones are unaffected.

name: Spanning Light
description: Range WP yd, WPB rounds. A bridge of light up to WPB yd long and wide; each +2 SL adds WPB yd to length or width.

name: Burst Orb
description: A blast of raw magic on all foes in a WPB-yd burst; the damage grows with extra SL.

name: Lance Bolt
description: A focused bolt of magic strikes one foe; the damage grows with extra SL.

name: Elemental Exhale
description: A breath of the caster’s lore strikes a foe and those near it; the lore adds a rider (fire, cold, shock, poison, acid, smoke) by hand.

name: Arcing Strike
description: A rupturing spur of magic hits a foe and chains to nearby foes, weaker each leap; extra SL add a leap.

name: Acid Veins
description: Self, TB rounds or hours. Rounds: the caster’s blood burns attackers like a corrosive creature. Hours: biting parasites die and diseases are purged.

name: Gloom Sight
description: Self, IB rounds. The caster sees in the dark as if with natural dark vision.

name: Flicker Wreath
description: Self, WPB rounds. Swirling magic around the caster distracts foes, as a creature with the distracting trait.

name: Overhead Bastion
description: Self, WPB-yd area, WPB rounds. Anyone inside gains Ward 6+ against magic and ranged attacks from outside; movement is free.

name: Slip Grip
description: Range WP yd, 1 target, instant. The target drops a held item unless a Challenging Dexterity test passes; each +2 SL gives -1 SL to it.

name: Sky Lift
description: Self, WPB rounds. The caster flies, by wings, a pillar of light or any other means.

name: Ribbon Guard
description: Self, WPB rounds. The caster adds WPB SL to dispel attempts.

name: Unseen Hand
description: Range WP yd, 1 round. Moves a non-sentient object up to WPB yd by will (Strength = Willpower); +2 SL adds WPB yd.

name: Plain Veil
description: Self, WP minutes. The caster seems nonmagical to magic senses; no other spells can be cast and a channelling test ends it.

name: Binding Wrap
description: Vines, shadows or cloth wrap one foe in an entangling grip (WPB rounds, Strength = Willpower).

name: Menace Mantle
description: Self, WPB rounds. The caster gains Fear 1; each +3 SL adds 1 to the Fear rating.

name: Shove Wave
description: Self, WPB-yd burst. Foes around are pushed back WPB yd, ignore AP, and fall prone; the damage grows with extra SL.

name: Hush Field
description: Self, WPB-yd area, WPB minutes. No sound passes in or out; casting inside is one difficulty step harder.

name: Short Step
description: Self, instant. The caster teleports up to WPB + SL yd, crossing gaps and obstacles.

name: Dread Mantle
description: Self, WPB rounds. The caster gains Terror 1; each +3 SL adds 1 to the Terror rating.

name: Ward Shell
description: Self, WPB rounds. The caster gains Ward 7+, turning aside hits on a lucky roll.

name: Claw Bloom
description: Amber talons sprout from your nails: unarmed strikes turn magical, hit harder and cause bleeding, and you can scale sheer walls. Lasts Willpower bonus rounds.

name: Wild Shape
description: You reshape into a chosen beast from the bestiary for Toughness minutes, taking its body stats and traits. You cannot speak or cast; Wounds carry over when you revert.

name: Herd Command
description: A beast of modest size accepts you as pack leader and fights to protect you, obeying simple orders for Willpower bonus days. Afterwards it will not attack you.

name: Fang and Feather Speech
description: You can speak with beasts for Willpower minutes and gain +2 SL on animal handling and charming tests. You cannot speak other tongues or cast while it lasts.

name: Carrion Cloud
description: A flock of birds tears at foes in the area, hitting them and blinding them. It lingers for Willpower bonus rounds and can be steered with a Charm Animal test.

name: Stalker Pelt
description: A shimmering predator mantle gives +20 Toughness, keen smell, dark vision and a fearsome aura for Willpower bonus rounds.

name: Gilded Javelin
description: A spear of amber light flies at one foe within Strength yards, ignoring leather and fur armour. You choose the hit location and the wound bleeds.

name: Feral Surge
description: Savage power gives +1 Move, +30 Strength and Toughness, a bite and frenzy for Willpower bonus rounds. You cannot use Language or Lore skills meanwhile.

name: Quiet Circle
description: You inscribe a warding circle around you; undead cannot enter or leave it for Willpower minutes.

name: Reaper Blade
description: You conjure a magical scythe (halberd) dealing Strength bonus + Willpower bonus + 4 damage; undead foes gain no Advantage against you. Lasts Willpower bonus rounds.

name: Spirit Whirl
description: A ball of ghostly flame breaks everyone in the area (+1 Broken); undead also take a magic hit ignoring Toughness bonus and armour. Instant.

name: Soul Draw
description: A touch drains a soul: magic hit ignoring Toughness bonus and armour; every 2 Wounds dealt cut the target's max Wounds by 1 and add 1 SL to your channelling pool.

name: Last Whisper
description: Touch a body dead less than a day to let its soul speak for Willpower bonus rounds. It cannot act, will not be forced to answer, but never lies.

name: Dusk Shroud
description: A shroud of dusk grants Armour Points equal to your Willpower bonus on all locations and Fear 1 for Willpower bonus rounds. Every +2 SL adds 1 Fear.

name: Vital Siphon
description: A magic hit ignoring armour at one target within Willpower yards; you shed all Fatigue and heal 1 Wound for every 2 Wounds dealt.

name: Mercy Stroke
description: A touch ends a creature already at 0 Wounds; death follows swiftly and it cannot be raised as undead. Instant.

name: Cinder Mantle
description: A fiery cloak makes you immune to mundane fire, lets you ignore Ablaze, and gives Ward 7+ against magical fire for Willpower bonus rounds.

name: Sear Seal
description: Hot hands seal a wound: the ally heals Wounds and loses all Bleeding, and the wound will not fester. Painful for those unused to flame.

name: Brow Blaze
description: A crown of flame inspires you: a leadership boost, a fearsome aura, and +1 SL on channelling and casting of fire for Willpower bonus rounds.

name: Rallying Embers
description: Your fiery voice rouses allies within Fellowship bonus yards: they lose Broken and Fatigued conditions and may attempt to shake off frenzy. Instant.

name: Blaze Brand
description: You wreathe a sword in flame for Willpower bonus rounds: Strength bonus + 6 damage, damaging and magical, and each hit sets the target Ablaze.

name: Furnace Burst
description: A forge-hot blast hits the centre hard and burns all in the area, setting them Ablaze. The fire lingers for Willpower bonus rounds.

name: Cleansing Burn
description: Fierce flame scours the area, setting flammables and creatures Ablaze and burning corrupt matter away. Sustain it with Channelling tests for Willpower bonus rounds.

name: Static Cage
description: A cage of sparks gives +3 Armour Points against metal weapons and arrows; attackers with metal melee weapons take 6 damage to the striking arm. Willpower bonus rounds.

name: Falling Star
description: You call a comet onto an area within Initiative yards. At the end of the next round it crashes down, burning and knocking foes Prone; a test can shift the impact.

name: Forked Arc
description: A bolt of chain lightning leaps from foe to foe, blinding each; damage drops with every jump and ignores metal armour.

name: Fickle Omen
description: Allies within Initiative bonus yards share one pool of Fortune points for Willpower bonus rounds, drawn first come, first served; leftovers are split fairly.

name: Ill-Starred Mark
description: You may spend Fortune points to force the marked target within Initiative yards to reroll tests, for Initiative bonus rounds.

name: Omen Glance
description: A glimpse of the future grants +1 Fortune point for Initiative bonus rounds; every +2 SL adds another.

name: Omen Reading
description: You read the signs and gain 3 Fortune points for Initiative bonus rounds; every +2 SL adds another.

name: Omen of Ruin
description: You divine a portent of doom and gain +1 Fate point for as many rounds as your full Initiative value.

name: Bark Hide
description: The target's skin turns bark-hard: +2 Toughness bonus but -10 Agility and Dexterity for Willpower bonus rounds. Touch.

name: Soil Vigour
description: Wholesome earth energy mends allies in the area who stand on bare ground, healing them each round for Willpower bonus rounds.

name: Burrow Pool
description: You sink into the ground and burst out at the start of the next round anywhere within Willpower yards; whoever you erupt under is thrown aside and falls Prone.

name: Loam Meal
description: The touched target needs neither food nor drink for Willpower bonus days.

name: Briar Thicket
description: Thorny brambles burst over the area: crossing foes risk being Entangled and bleeding. Lasts Willpower bonus rounds, then the growth turns mundane.

name: Root Survey
description: Touch the earth for a minute to sense a map of land, woods and water within Initiative bonus miles; settlements show as bare patches.

name: Wilt Mending
description: You revive a blighted site within Willpower bonus yards: a dry river runs, a foul well turns clean, a field ripens, a sick animal is cured. Instant.

name: Mending Surge
description: A touch grants steady regeneration: the target heals Wounds and loses Bleeding and Fatigue, lasting Willpower bonus rounds.

name: Purging Halo
description: A cleansing halo hits all in the area weaker than your Willpower: daemonic and undead creatures become unstable, and those already unstable drop to 0 Wounds.

name: Flare Flash
description: A blinding flash from your hand or staff: everyone looking at you within Willpower bonus yards takes 3 Blinded conditions. Instant.

name: Calm Mind
description: The touched target ignores negative mental modifiers, such as Stunned or fears, for Intelligence minutes.

name: Fiend Sunder
description: Blast one fiend within Willpower bonus yards: if its Toughness is above your Intelligence but under double it, halve its max Wounds; if lower, it is banished in a blinding flash.

name: Lattice Snare
description: A net of riddles leaves a target frozen with indecision: it loses its Move and is Stunned for Intelligence bonus rounds. Bestial creatures are immune.

name: Sanctum Glow
description: A radiant aura for Willpower bonus rounds: fiends, undead and mutants cannot enter, those inside are Broken, and no Corruption can be gained there.

name: Mending Gleam
description: A cleansing light heals Wounds equal to your Intelligence bonus and purges poisons and intoxicants. A hard test may also wipe a recent Corruption point.

name: Quicksilver Mind
description: A lattice of light quickens your thoughts: +20 Intelligence and Initiative for Willpower bonus rounds.

name: Smelt Touch
description: You melt one non-magical metal object within Willpower bonus yards; it is dropped if held, and its wearer takes a magic hit ignoring armour. A smith can reuse the metal.

name: Temper Bands
description: Bands of metal power a weapon: +Willpower bonus damage, magical and unbreakable for Willpower bonus rounds; every +3 SL adds a quality or removes a flaw.

name: Reforge Edge
description: You add one quality or remove one flaw on a metal item for Willpower minutes; every +2 SL allows another change.

name: Scale Mirage
description: A glittering robe lights the area like a candelabra, gives +2 Armour Points on all locations, and enemies Engaged with you risk Blinded. Willpower bonus rounds.

name: Weight Shift
description: Within the area, you choose to make carried loads two steps heavier or weightless (no Burdened) for Willpower bonus rounds.

name: Soft Iron
description: Touched metal grows warm and pliable: you bend or mangle it by hand, or attempt an Art or Trade test for finer work. Willpower bonus rounds.

name: Gilt Illusion
description: A touched metal object truly turns to gold for Willpower minutes, then reverts; it may be ruined meanwhile.

name: Ore Wrench
description: Metal is wrenched from foes and the earth: all in the area take a heavy hit ignoring armour and are stunned, blinded and deafened for Willpower bonus rounds.

name: Web of Seeming
description: You spin an illusion over the area for Intelligence minutes; only those with second sight can sense it, and a test can make it move for a round.

name: Thought Slip
description: The target forgets you entirely for Intelligence minutes; afterwards a contested test decides whether the loss becomes permanent.

name: Throttling Dark
description: Shadowy tendrils wrap a foe's neck: it is Fatigued, cannot speak and begins to suffocate, for Willpower bonus rounds.

name: Borrowed Face
description: You take the likeness of a humanoid you know for Intelligence bonus minutes; only those with second sight may see through it.

name: Murk Bank
description: A bank of shadowy mist blinds foes in the area for Willpower bonus rounds; the table also deafens and tires them, and moving through it risks falling Prone.

name: Night Mount
description: You summon a shadowy riding steed until dawn; it counts as a riding horse with dark sight, fear and a ward, and fades at sunrise.

name: Dark Door
description: You vanish and reappear anywhere within Willpower yards; enemies Engaged with you when you vanish are caught Surprised.

name: Cloak of Nothing
description: You wrap the touched target in shadow: invisible to mundane senses for Willpower bonus rounds, ending if they make noise or attack.

name: Hearth Cheer
description: Friendly warmth fills the area around you for minutes: Fellowship tests there gain +1 SL, and hostility and hatred stop working on those inside.

name: Fruitful Plea
description: A plea for fertility: within the duration the touched target conceives a child, if biologically possible. The spell ends once it takes effect.

name: Mire Stride
description: Your spirit slips into the hedge for minutes: invisible, silent, unable to affect the world, yet able to meet spirits. Your body lies helpless. Magical damage ends the spell.

name: Dreamless Cup
description: Enchants a cup for hours: whoever drinks it may choose to forget one specific person for good.

name: Charged Draught
description: Charges a prepared draught for hours. Whoever drinks it while the spell lasts heals Wounds and is cured of one disease; each +2 SL cures one more disease.

name: Owl Eyes
description: Your eyes see into the spirit world for minutes, so you can see all invisible creatures.

name: Warding Knot
description: Imbues a small charm for days: its bearer gains +2 SL to resist magical effects and Corruption.

name: Lost Flock Sight
description: Drop a creature's trace into a bowl of water and scry for minutes; the table then tells you where that creature is.

name: Barren Touch
description: Blights a place or beast: a tavern's food spoils, a well turns foul, a field's crops rot overnight, or an animal sickens and yields nothing and dies in days.

name: Crawling Plague
description: Summons a swarm of vermin that engages each target for rounds; a Charm Animal test redirects the swarms. They vanish when the spell ends.

name: Pinprick Doll
description: Stab a doll to hurt the target for rounds: the body causes Fatigued and a fall risk, the head causes Stunned, a limb goes useless. Another test hits a new place.

name: Age Mask
description: Changes one adult's apparent age to any you choose within adulthood, for hours.

name: Haunted Hearth
description: Haunts a place for days. Intruders (except witches) gain Fatigued; those failing a Psychology test also become Broken, until they leave.

name: Pale Mending
description: Pale light soothes a touched target and heals Wounds; the caster may also lift one Fatigued and one Stunned.

name: Ill Gaze
description: A withering stare: the target gains Fatigued and may also suffer Fear; a strong result adds more Fatigued.

name: Snapped Laces Hex
description: Petty ill luck plagues one target: -1 SL on all tests and no Fortune spending. A keepsake of the target removes the need for line of sight.

name: Unmake Minor Fiend
description: Opposed Endurance test against a fiend of average size or smaller: if you win it is destroyed and you may raise one characteristic by +10 for the duration.

name: Eightfold Seal
description: A drawn floor seal for minutes: fiends cannot enter or leave it.

name: Fiend Scent
description: You instantly learn whether a manifested fiend is within range: summoned, bound into an item, or possessing someone.

name: Rend the Veil
description: Tears a rent and a lesser fiend appears for rounds. An opposed Channelling/Cool test decides: it obeys one literal command and leaves, or it attacks.

name: Septic Bloom
description: Septic fluids bloom in a foe's wounds: one of the target's Wounds becomes a festering wound.

name: Plague Mist
description: A thin mist gathers around you for rounds: living creatures in the area must pass an Endurance test or suffer nausea. Followers of the rot are immune.

name: Rotten Stream
description: You spew a stream of acid and filth that ignores armour; targets taking heavy Wounds may catch a wasting rot.

name: Honeyed Surrender
description: Euphoric sensation floods the target for rounds: at the start of each round they test Endurance or lose their Move and Action.

name: Pain Turned Sweet
description: For rounds the target feels no pain, but on a Critical Wound must pass an Endurance test or drop their weapons and stand helpless.

name: Fickle Gift
description: Borrow one spell from any list for days as if memorised, but you cannot record it. A Miscast with the borrowed spell erases it.

name: Warping Coil
description: Coils of magical fire wrap the target for rounds: Prone and helpless, and at each round's end an Endurance test or gain a Corruption point.

name: Mirage Swirl
description: Beguiling visions fill the area for rounds: you and allies gain the Distracting trait, and the visions do not distract one another.

name: Betrayal Whisper
description: Treacherous thoughts fan discontent in targets for rounds: they feel animosity toward allies, cannot pass Advantage, and on a Critical may turn on the nearest ally.

name: Grave Rising
description: Old bones claw out of the ground in the area: 1 + SL skeletons obeying you rise until sunrise, starting Prone; +1 per 2 SL. They fall if you die or fall unconscious.

name: Bone Binding
description: Raises corpses or skeletons in the area under your command until sunrise, starting Prone. They fall if you die or fall unconscious; each +2 SL raises more.

name: Howling Skull
description: A screaming spectral skull flies in a line, hurting only non-undead; those wounded must pass a Psychology test or become Broken.

name: Vigour of the Dead
description: Undead targets gain a free Move or Action as the spell is cast; each +2 SL invigorates more targets.

name: Keen Hand Boon
description: The target gains +10 Weapon Skill for 6 rounds. Each +2 SL: +18 ft range, +1 target or +6 rounds.

name: Held Breath Boon
description: For 6 rounds the target needs no breath and ignores suffocation. Each +2 SL: +18 ft range, +1 target or +6 rounds.

name: Silver Tongue Boon
description: The target gains +10 Fellowship for 6 rounds. Each +2 SL: +18 ft range, +1 target or +6 rounds.

name: Honest Heart Boon
description: For 6 rounds the target must pass a Cool test to break their deity's strictures, or shame stops the act. Each +2 SL: +18 ft range, +1 target or +6 rounds.

name: Stout Heart Boon
description: The target gains +10 Willpower for 6 rounds. Each +2 SL: +18 ft range, +1 target or +6 rounds.

name: Deft Fingers Boon
description: The target gains +10 Dexterity for 6 rounds. Each +2 SL: +18 ft range, +1 target or +6 rounds.

name: Second Chance Boon
description: For 6 rounds the target may reroll their next failed test; the reroll stands. Each +2 SL: +18 ft range, +1 target or +6 rounds.

name: Light Foot Boon
description: The target gains +10 Agility for 6 rounds. Each +2 SL: +18 ft range, +1 target or +6 rounds.

name: Iron Hide Boon
description: The target gains +10 Toughness for 6 rounds. Each +2 SL: +18 ft range, +1 target or +6 rounds.

name: Sure Aim Boon
description: The target gains +10 Ballistic Skill for 6 rounds. Each +2 SL: +18 ft range, +1 target or +6 rounds.

name: Strong Arm Boon
description: The target gains +10 Strength for 6 rounds. Each +2 SL: +18 ft range, +1 target or +6 rounds.

name: Shame Ward Boon
description: For 6 rounds enemies must pass a Cool test to attack the target, or shame makes them choose another target or action. Each +2 SL: +18 ft range, +1 target or +6 rounds.

name: Fever Ease Boon
description: Shortens one disease the target has by 1 day; only once per disease per person. Each +2 SL: +18 ft range or +1 target.

name: Hallowed Edge Boon
description: For 6 rounds the target's weapon counts as Magical. Each +2 SL: +18 ft range, +1 target or +6 rounds.

name: Cruel Cut Boon
description: For 6 rounds, the next time the target inflicts a Critical Wound, roll twice and take the better result. Each +2 SL: +18 ft range, +1 target or +6 rounds.

name: Shrug It Off Boon
description: The target removes one condition, except a social stigma one. Each +2 SL: +18 ft range or +1 target.

name: Clear Head Boon
description: The target gains +10 Intelligence for 6 rounds. Each +2 SL: +18 ft range, +1 target or +6 rounds.

name: Quick Wits Boon
description: The target gains +10 Initiative for 6 rounds. Each +2 SL: +18 ft range, +1 target or +6 rounds.

name: Stilled Sails
description: Calms wind and sea around one ship in a Fellowship-yard area for an hour; range of a few miles.

name: Brine Lungs
description: Target chokes as if drowning and becomes fatigued, then stunned when it ends. Lasts Fellowship-bonus rounds; works on any creature.

name: Favouring Gale
description: Raises a steady fair wind for one vessel for an hour, giving top speed and +1 SL on its sailing tests.

name: Tide Larder
description: Draws fish from nearby water to feed one person (two at sea); each 2 SL feeds one more person.

name: Deck Heave
description: Target reels as on a storm deck: blinded, deafened and fatigued, and may fall prone. Lasts Fellowship-bonus rounds.

name: Surface Stride
description: You walk on open water at least 10 yards wide without sinking, for Fellowship-bonus minutes.

name: Death Knell
description: Touch shows you how the target will die. Once per character; may unlock buying a talent at a discount. Resolved by the table.

name: Parting Rite
description: Ensures a corpse's soul passes on, bars necromancy on it, and destroys an undead construct within 3 ft.

name: Threshold Line
description: Draws a ground line up to 24 ft long until sunrise; undead must pass a Cool test to cross it.

name: Reprieve
description: Touch holds a willing target at 0 Wounds unconscious but stable for Fellowship-bonus hours.

name: Smiting Ash
description: Burst of ash around you wounds only undead for 1d10, ignoring Toughness and armour; +1 per SL. Area is Fellowship-bonus yards.

name: Reaper Mien
description: Your face turns cadaverous and you cause Fear that undead are not immune to. Lasts Fellowship-bonus rounds.

name: Blinding Standard
description: Flash from your banner blinds every non-cult onlooker who faces you; +1 target per 2 SL.

name: Scout Sight
description: You steer a spectral eagle within Fellowship yards and see through it; your own body is blind meanwhile. Lasts Fellowship-bonus rounds.

name: Shield Wall Glow
description: Allies within Fellowship yards gain +1 AP on all locations for Fellowship-bonus rounds; Fellowship-bonus targets.

name: Blessed Spear
description: Your spear gains Damaging and counts as magical for Fellowship-bonus rounds.

name: Battle Fury
description: Allies within Fellowship-bonus yards of you gain Frenzy for Fellowship-bonus rounds.

name: Steadfast Ranks
description: Allies within Fellowship-bonus yards gain a drilling talent for Fellowship-bonus rounds.

name: Open Door Riddle
description: Undoes one lock, latch or knot on a door, window or hatch; +1 method per 2 SL.

name: Prowler Sight
description: You steer a spectral cat within Fellowship yards and see through it; your own body is blind meanwhile. Lasts Fellowship-bonus rounds.

name: Loaded Fate
description: You gain 1 Fortune point, +1 per 2 SL, until session end; cannot be cast again until your Fortune is 0.

name: Light Fingers Boon
description: Touched target gains +10 Agility and +10 Stealth and reduces fall damage by 1 for Fellowship-bonus rounds.

name: Borrowed Mask
description: Illusions of a purse and attire hide one item on the target for Fellowship-bonus minutes; +1 effect per 2 SL.

name: Fading Memory
description: Target passes unnoticed while acting quietly, for Fellowship-bonus rounds; not a condition.

name: Sudden Orchard
description: Edible plants sprout at touch, yielding food for one person each round for a round.

name: Green Canopy
description: Finds a natural shelter for one person while camped, +1 per 2 SL. Outdoors only.

name: Cradle Kin
description: Senses all living creatures within Fellowship yards for Fellowship-bonus rounds. Outdoors only.

name: Cradle Relief
description: Fellowship-bonus targets within Fellowship yards each remove 1 condition; a fully clean target gains +1 SL next turn.

name: Gentle Hands
description: Touch restores Fellowship-bonus Wounds or cures one disease; 10-minute prayer; repeat per 2 SL.

name: Bond Blessing
description: Blesses a union for Fellowship-bonus hours, with conception where possible. Narrative.

name: Monk Fortitude
description: Target feels no pain and ignores condition penalties for Fellowship-bonus rounds.

name: Soothing Hush
description: Touch strips psychology traits from the target, then a deep sleep follows. Lasts Fellowship-bonus minutes.

name: Merciful Tears
description: After a prayer lasting 10 minus Fellowship-bonus rounds, touch heals one critical wound; cannot regrow limbs.

name: Cleansed Slate
description: Touch removes 1 recently gained Corruption point, +1 per 2 SL; a fumble backfires on the caster.

name: Draw the Poison
description: Touch purges one poison or disease; the caster takes 1d10 minus Fellowship bonus Wounds per item.

name: Shouldered Pain
description: Caster takes damage meant for the target, adding Fellowship bonus to Toughness. Lasts Fellowship-bonus rounds.

name: Radiant Zeal
description: Allies who see you lose Broken and become fearless; foes of one kind fear you. Lasts Fellowship-bonus rounds.

name: Spellward Shout
description: Spells aimed into the area around you take -2 SL for Fellowship-bonus rounds; area is Fellowship-bonus yards.

name: Hallowed Hammer
description: Your war hammer is magical, deals +Fellowship bonus damage and sets the target ablaze. Lasts Fellowship-bonus rounds.

name: Spirit Pyre
description: Burst around you deals 1d10 Wounds ignoring Toughness and armour to everyone in a Fellowship-bonus-yard area, extra vs fiends and undead.

name: Twin Star Fall
description: A comet strikes within Fellowship yards: 1d10 + SL Wounds ignoring Toughness and armour, target ablaze. Outdoors only.

name: Hate the Wicked
description: Allies within Fellowship-bonus yards gain hatred of named enemy groups for Fellowship-bonus rounds; +2 SL after a kill.

name: Beastsense
description: Touched target gains one heightened sense and wakes when a threat nears. Lasts Fellowship-bonus hours.

name: Wild Ally
description: A local wild animal within Fellowship yards obeys you for Fellowship-bonus minutes. Summon: resolved by the table.

name: Stag Leap
description: You gain +1 Movement and a leaping talent that auto-passes leaps for Fellowship-bonus rounds.

name: Huntmaster Trail
description: You cannot lose a chosen quarry's trail and gain +1 SL against it for Fellowship-bonus hours.

name: Snare Roots
description: Roots ensnare everyone in a Fellowship-bonus-yard area within Fellowship yards: entangled, strength equal to Fellowship.

name: Fang Gift
description: You gain Bite and Weapon traits and your attacks are magical for Fellowship-bonus rounds.

name: Frost Pelt
description: Touched target suffers no mechanical penalty from cold for Fellowship-bonus hours.

name: Cold Verdict
description: 1d10 Wounds ignoring Toughness and armour, +1 per SL. Backfires on a target that is neither weak nor cowardly.

name: Winter Glare
description: You cause Fear and all others within Fellowship yards lose Advantage each round, for Fellowship-bonus rounds.

name: Pack Frenzy
description: An ally gets a free frenzy test and +1d10 on its first melee hit (exploding) for Fellowship-bonus rounds.

name: Frostbite Bolt
description: Your axe is magical, deals +SL damage, fatigues the target and stops bleeding for Fellowship-bonus rounds.

name: Pack Howl
description: A white beast within Fellowship yards fights for you for Fellowship-bonus rounds. Summon: resolved by the table.

name: Even-Handed Blade
description: Your sword ignores AP and is magical; criminals risk unconsciousness. Lasts Fellowship-bonus rounds.

name: Honest Tongue
description: Ask one question within Fellowship-bonus yards; the target answers truthfully unless it wins a Cool test.

name: Unswayed Judge
description: Perception tests see through illusions and Intuition tests detect lies for Fellowship-bonus rounds.

name: Truth Bind
description: A lying suspect within Fellowship-bonus yards is entangled for Fellowship-bonus rounds; a wrong accusation costs you.

name: Owl Counsel
description: You gain +20 Intelligence and sight, menace and night-vision talents for Fellowship-bonus rounds.

name: Witness Aura
description: Listeners believe your true words for Fellowship-bonus rounds.
